DISCOVERY 612, DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY'S MOTION FOR TERMINATING AND MONETARY SANCTIONS, OR, IN THE ALTERNATIVE, FOR EVIDENTIARY SANCTIONS IS GRANTED AS IT SEEKS TERMINATING SANCTIONS. NO OPPOSITION HAS BEEN FILED. THE COURT FINDS THAT ADDITIONAL ORDERS TO PARTICIPATE IN DISCOVERY WOULD NOT RESULT IN COMPLIANCE.
